name: Withry Hope Gakuen
source: You're a new student at Withry Hope Academy. Within a year while training in swordplay and magic, gain the heart of the person you're interested in! While aiming for love train morning through evening to become a great swordsman and magician.
translation: 你是怀斯利霍普学院的新生。在一年之内，一边训练剑术与魔法，一边赢得意中人的芳心吧！以恋爱为目标，从早到晚努力修行，成为伟大的剑士与魔法师。
